editorial:
You know that friend who is always there but never sees what is right in front of them? That is the heart of this romantic comedy. Tom and Hannah have been best friends for a decade, with Tom dating around and Hannah waiting for the right guy. Just when Tom finally starts to feel ready for something real, Hannah gets engaged and asks him to be her maid of honor. It is a fun, light setup that mixes awkward wedding planning with a slow realization that friendship might be something more.

The movie moves quickly and leans on charm, silly moments, and a few big romantic gestures. Patrick Dempsey and Michelle Monaghan have easy chemistry, and the wedding chaos keeps things moving. It is not deep, and some jokes feel familiar, but it is an easy watch for a cozy night. If you like rom-coms with a best-friends-to-lovers twist, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for a movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Tom realizes he cannot let Hannah marry someone else, so he rushes to Scotland to stop the wedding. After a messy but heartfelt interruption, Hannah sees that Tom is the one she really wants. They finally end up together in the end, turning their long friendship into a romance and leaving the wedding behind for their own happy ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and best-friends-to-lovers stories.
